discarded_baseline_attempt.cause: Without PYTHONUTF8=1, worker subprocesses emitted CP1252 bytes while parent decoded as UTF-8, producing UnicodeDecodeError in subprocess reader threads. The run was stopped before output files were written.
discarded_baseline_attempt.resolution: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 for parent and all worker processes; one-worker smoke then returned valid JSON with exit 0.

discarded_candidate_preflight.cause: Isolated worktree lacked Git-ignored public training resource 93b4f4b3.json.
discarded_candidate_preflight.resolution: Set ARC2_PAYLOAD_ROOT to the main repository public-data root; candidate preflight passed with status ok and template_examples=2.
